description: AT&T AI Foundry — Enterprise Customer & Operational Data Platform with GenAI Integration. Director-grade working prototype: real state changes, deterministic LangGraph-style agent, grounded RAG, measurable outcomes. Synthetic demo data only; live Groq LLM only when GROQ_API_KEY is set, no real AT&T systems.
name: att-ai-foundry

scripts.build: npm run build:api && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:api: mkdir -p api && for f in health run-case rag stair; do ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild api-src/$f.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=api/$f.js --log-level=warning; done
